limitations: Pure isolated verification is not HTTP/runtime/official-source integration proof
No provider/model/worker, live DB, production restart, deployment or graph query executed
No V2 implementation or Hermes freeze performed
scope: Human-facing contract and actual runtime control readiness

results.existing_capability: Evidence and review console with authenticated preview; not a runtime preference controller
results.new_capability: None; contract documents real capabilities and missing decisions without cosmetic selectors
results.mapping: Human intent → API → existing authority → actual execution not implemented
results.ui_changes: NONE; blocked before dependency-specific UI implementation
results.implementation_stop_reason: Unknown selection ownership/lifecycle and mode/source semantics require architecture decisions

decisions_required: Profile to actual installed model mapping; whether selection is request/session/operator-wide; authorized owner lifecycle, scope and expiry without a second configuration truth.
Approved semantics for direct/evidence modes, mandatory safety stages and treatment of missing evidence. Do not invent another engine.
Depends on MODEL-CONTROL and ORCHESTRATION-CONTROL decisions before UI implementation.
